subject.title: fix(mattermost): preserve text-block boundaries in draft preview (#87322)

question: Should this PR land with separate Mattermost posts for existing opt-in block configurations and an optional DraftStreamLoop.takePending SDK type?
rationale: The code path now looks focused and well-covered, but the changed post shape and exported type are product/API contract choices automation should not accept on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept this focused fix

options.title: Keep SDK surface internal
options.body: Ask for a narrower implementation that avoids changing the exported DraftStreamLoop type before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader streaming policy
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want one cross-channel streaming design decision before changing Mattermost block-mode semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept this focused fix
